# Curated Public-Domain Hymn Fixtures (M2.4 / M2-A1)

All 25 curated hymn fixtures in this folder are strictly public domain worldwide
(published before 1923 and authored/translated by writers who died in 1939 or earlier).
Chord charts are simple worship voicings authored directly for Selah test fixtures.

Each fixture directory includes the same hymn in four paste formats (`plain.txt`,
`markers.txt`, `chords.txt`, `song.cho`) paired with `expected.json` asserting 100%
canonical section, arrangement, and aligned chord output (`M2-A1`).
